title: 00570 - P164B/005707
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  outdated Oil Pressure Switch.
Verify Oil pressure is within the manufacture's specifications, see the Official Factory Repair Information.
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: 2011 ~ 2014 Audi S4, S5, S5, Cabriolet, A6, A7, Q5, Q7 with 3.0L FSI vehicles, verify the Oil Pressure Switch (F22) is the updated type.
See TSB 01 14 85 2036761
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2021/MC-10204727-0001.pdf NHTSA
